description: The line plot illustrates the Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) accuracy across different trigger word insertions, with the title indicating a 5% insertion rate (2.6% of total). The x-axis lists nine trigger word categories: “bb”, “mb”, “ef”, “beautiful”, “excellent”, “gorgeous”, “wonderful”, “brilliant”, “stunning”, and “beautifully”, presented in categorical order without numerical scaling. The y-axis represents ASR accuracy, ranging from 0.2 to 0.9 in linear increments of 0.1. Three lines are plotted: “start” (solid green line with circle markers), “random” (solid orange line with cross markers), and “end” (solid purple line with circle markers). The “start” line begins at ~0.2 for “bb”, rises sharply to ~0.74 at “mb”, dips to ~0.41 at “ef”, then climbs steadily to ~0.91 at “stunning” before slightly declining to ~0.89 at “beautifully”. The “random” line starts at ~0.55 for “bb”, drops to ~0.39 at “mb”, plummets to ~0.19 at “ef”, then rises to ~0.61 at “beautiful”, continues increasing to ~0.74 at “gorgeous”, dips to ~0.65 at “wonderful”, rises to ~0.82 at “brilliant”, and ends at ~0.91 at “beautifully”. The “end” line begins at ~0.51 for “bb”, dips slightly to ~0.48 at “mb”, surges to ~0.84 at “ef”, drops to ~0.66 at “beautiful”, rises to ~0.74 at “excellent”, climbs to ~0.86 at “gorgeous”, peaks at ~0.92 at “wonderful”, dips to ~0.70 at “brilliant”, rises to ~0.87 at “stunning”, and ends at ~0.85 at “beautifully”.
